announcements.title: V5.9.2 is out — downloads and subtitles are back
announcements.banner: The backend moved to opaque token links. V5.9.2 learns the new handshake: playback, downloads, saved episodes (DUB included), and subtitles work again — update in place.
body:
Quick one, because this one is all plumbing: the backend swapped raw playback URLs for opaque token links and stopped echoing provider Referer/UA headers. The app was still asking for the old handshake, so playback, downloads, and saved episodes could fail depending on which screen you opened first.

V5.9.2 roots every relative token link at api.aniraku.tech before the player or downloader touches it. Downloads save again, and saved bundles open even when the copy was downloaded in DUB — the Downloads hub used to forget which track you saved, then look for a SUB file that was never there.

Subtitles are fixed too. They still ride the Aniraku proxy, and now that the API no longer hands out provider Referer/UA headers, the proxy supplies the browser identity itself. Subtitle URLs also get rooted at the API host like everything else, so a tokenized link can never reach the subtitle parser as a relative path.

Install straight over V5.9.1. Your account, library, history, and downloaded files are untouched.

If something still refuses to play, tell me the anime, episode, and whether it was SUB or DUB — that is the fastest way to kill the next bug.

Now go enjoy some anime.

— the guy who still hasn't slept enough

announcements.title: Old builds lose sign-in — your account does not
announcements.banner: Running anything older than v5.8.0? Sign-in is being retired on it. Your account is untouched — update and sign back in.
body:
Heads-up, and it's an easy one: sign-in is being switched off for builds older than v5.8.0. If the app suddenly refuses to log you in, that's not a ban, not a bug, and definitely not personal — it's just an old build knocking on a door that moved.

Your account is NOT affected. Nothing is deleted, nothing expires, your library and history are exactly where you left them. Update the app to the latest release, sign back in, and pretend this never happened.

V5.9 shipped the big stuff meanwhile: downloads rebuilt (fMP4 and separate-audio providers finally save with sound), shared links now open the app, quality switching keeps audio, and the sign-up got a whole lot friendlier.

If Aniraku works when you need it — mail me. If it broke — mail me twice. Every message lands in my inbox and every one of them is fuel for the next fix. Silence is how a project quietly dies at 3 a.m.

Still looking for a couple of kind souls to help grow a proper Discord and Telegram community — I'm the quiet guy who wants everyone to watch anime in peace, so a hand setting things up right would mean a lot.

And if you can, a small Patreon pledge keeps the servers alive and the developer caffeinated. Bug reports are accepted. Compliments are hoarded. Both are read.

Now go enjoy some anime.

— the guy who still hasn't slept enough
